what: docs/prompt_audit.md item 4 and docs/open_experiments.md #24: the two markers this repo and the sister engine spell differently, rendered every way. Seven t2va arms from one shipped graph, each a patch of the prompt and the length only. Split-line contest (t2va_desert_crew, 294 frames): st_prose = ours, the whole line in one <d> and the continuity in the guide's phrases; st_split_tag = the sister form, the words split across the cut with <scenetrans> in the prose of both parts; st_tag_only = the tags at both connecting points with the words unsplit. Cutoff contest (t2va_cable_car, 328 frames): co_piped_tight = ours, </d><|cutoff|>; co_unpiped_spaced = the sister form, </d> <cutoff>; co_unpiped_tight and co_piped_spaced isolate spelling from spacing.
base_texts: prompt_bank/t2va_desert_crew.txt and prompt_bank/t2va_cable_car.txt; every variant was made by an asserted single substitution and graded 0 FAIL 0 WARN, and every patched graph passed bench/preflight_graph.py on 2026-09-01
owner_calls_2026-09-01: canvas 1344x768 (the graph's default, the trained canvas); two seeds per arm; all seven arms. Deferred the same day by the owner before anything was queued; nothing has rendered.
run: bench/run_graph_arms.py --manifest bench/marker_arms.json --runs 2 --seed 730451892 --warmup st_prose --out bench/results/<date>_marker_arms.jsonl   (about 45 minutes of card; needs a running, unarmed ComfyUI)
then: bench/blind_batch.py --jsonl bench/results/<date>_marker_arms.jsonl --session marker_arms --shuffle-seed 41 --brief-file bench/marker_arms_brief.md --pairs st_prose,st_split_tag --pairs st_prose,st_tag_only --pairs co_piped_tight,co_unpiped_spaced --pairs co_piped_tight,co_unpiped_tight --pairs co_piped_tight,co_piped_spaced ; the owner scores in score.html; bench/score_session.py joins the export with the key
reading: meets-the-brief per arm, never A/B: does the line audibly continue across the cut, and does the last line stop mid-word at the end of the clip. Two samples per contest are a presentation, not a distribution; the sister engine's marker decision waits on the verdict and reads it the same way.
server_state_when_built: the server started 2026-09-01 15:52 runs comfy_kitchen 0.2.31+sol.24908e1 (the sol-blk-cnt branch, first production-geometry render would be this batch) and the sol_attn_h3.py restructured in 9069b88; the Sol session asked to be told before anything odd in [h3-sol] lines or Sol stats is attributed to an arm

st_prose:5.prompt="integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, documentary, a wide shot frames a two-lane desert highway at midday, heat shimmer flattening the ridge behind and a yellow road roller parked on the gravel shoulder. A crew supervisor in a high-visibility vest and a wide-brimmed hat, on-screen, fifties, with a dry, carrying alto and an unhurried delivery (S1), stands at the centre line holding a clipboard, and a younger crew member in the same vest, on-screen, mid-twenties, with a light, slightly nasal tenor (S2), kneels over a seam of fresh asphalt at the right of frame. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed along the centre line toward the two of them. [Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot of the pair at the seam, the roller's drum filling the left edge. The supervisor (S1) taps the clipboard against her thigh and says: <d>[English] Give it another pass before the sun drops.</d> Her voice continues seamlessly across the cut. [Shot 3] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a low close shot of the roller drum meeting the seam, and the supervisor's last words carry over from the previous shot and remain audible across the transition. The camera holds a static shot on the drum. The younger crew member (S2) leans into frame above the drum and answers: <d>[English] Two more and it's flat.</d> He closes his mouth and steps back onto the gravel.

overall_soundscape: A diesel engine idles under a steady wash of hot wind across open ground. Gravel shifts under boots, a steel drum grinds over fresh asphalt with a low hiss, and a clipboard taps twice against fabric.

non_diegetic_music: N/A"

co_piped_tight:5.prompt="integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, flat cel shading with clean ink outlines and a limited winter palette, a wide shot frames a cable-car cabin climbing between two pylons above a snowed valley, the haul rope running out of frame at the top left. Inside the cabin a lift mechanic in a padded orange jacket, on-screen, thirties, with a bright, clipped tenor (S1), stands at the front window with a radio handset; a skier in a grey shell sits on the bench behind him, on-screen, and produces no vocal sound. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed alongside the cabin as it rises. The mechanic (S1) raises the handset and says: <d>[English] Pylon four is clear, take it up.</d> His mouth closes as the cabin passes the tower. [Shot 2] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a close shot of the mechanic's face against the glass, valley light sliding across the window behind him. The camera holds a static shot on him. He lowers the handset, watches the rope, then raises it again as the cabin slows and swings. The mechanic (S1) presses the transmit key and begins: <d>[English] Hold there, I want to look at the</d><|cutoff|>

overall_soundscape: A steady rope hum runs through the cabin under the creak of the hanger arm. Wind pushes against the windows, a boot shifts on the metal floor, and a radio handset clicks twice.

non_diegetic_music: A slow four-note synth arpeggio, joined by a low sustained pad that rises steadily in volume and is still rising at the final frame."
